title: Benchmark Scenario
description: Schema for network-automation agent benchmark scenarios

setup.description: Operator-applied configuration that creates the fault or baseline state

prompt.description: Task description given to the agent

args_contains.description: Substrings that must appear in the serialized args

required.description: Opt into strict args enforcement (outcome_lenient mode only)

forbidden_calls.description: Tool calls that immediately fail the scenario

scoring.description: Scoring algorithm: outcome (honest gate, checks staged diff/report), outcome_lenient (presence-only, read args advisory), or all_expected_present_and_ordered_no_forbidden (strict)

staged_diff_contains.description: Substrings that must appear in staged diff

staged_diff_matches_any.description: Regex patterns (at least one must match staged diff)

staged_diff_must_not_contain.description: Substrings that must NOT appear in staged diff (e.g. out-of-scope config that must not leak)

no_stage_expected.description: Fail if changes were staged (for discover scenarios, default false)

report_contains.description: Keywords that must appear in final_message (discover scenarios); a nested list is any-of

report_contains_by_device.description: Device name -> report_contains list that replaces report_contains for that device

report_order.description: Keywords that must occur in final_message in this order somewhere (case-insensitive); earlier out-of-order mentions are ignored

platforms.description: Platforms the scenario runs on (default: all)

device_scope.description: per_device (default) runs once per device; path is one multi-device record

devices.description: Explicit device subset, intersected with platforms

fault.description: Set lines planted by the operator before the attempt, removed by restore

devices.description: Run this check only for these target devices

read_only.description: Fail the attempt if any device has a commit since baseline other than the fault plant

domain.description: Config domain for smart truncation (e.g., 'system ntp', 'security policies')

expected_literals.description: Values a scorer depends on seeing, so mechubbench.redact's allowlist-shaped masking must leave them unmasked in the committed results/*.json. Either a bare non-IP identifier (a lab device/hostname), or an IP literal: a bare host address, or a CIDR range no wider than a single host (/32, /128) unless it falls inside a documentation/loopback range - mechubbench.redact.validate_expected_literal rejects anything wider at scenario load time (F4-7), since this field exempts specific values, not whole subnets, from masking
